Making money from a digital product isn’t about getting lucky. It’s about having a simple system and executing it consistently. Here’s the step-by-step 👇 1️⃣ Pick ONE problem Think about something your audience is struggling with. Weight loss. Confidence. Canva. Meditation. Making money. Content creation. Find a problem → create a solution. 2️⃣ Turn your knowledge into a simple product 📕💡 You don’t need to create a 200-page masterpiece. Create something that helps someone go from A → B. A guide, checklist, template, ebook or resource can be enough if it actually solves the problem. 3️⃣ Create content around the problem 📱 Don’t just post “buy my ebook.” Teach. Share tips. Show mistakes. Break down strategies. Tell stories. Answer common questions. Give people a reason to trust you BEFORE you ask them to buy. 4️⃣ Add a simple CTA 🔗 Tell people exactly what to do next. “Comment GUIDE.” “Link in bio.” “DM me PDF.” Don’t make people guess how to get your product. 5️⃣ Make the offer clear 💰 Explain: What they get Who it’s for What problem it solves What they’ll learn Why it’s useful Clarity converts. 6️⃣ Repeat the process 🔄 One post might flop. That doesn’t mean the business doesn’t work. Keep creating. Keep testing hooks. Keep improving your offer. Keep listening to your audience. The goal isn’t to go viral once. The goal is to build a system that can keep generating attention and sales. So while someone is sitting there hating… You could be learning a skill, building an audience and creating another income stream. 🧠📈 Focus on building, not proving. Your results will always speak louder than their opinions. 🚀 Follow me for more practical ways to build and monetize your personal brand. 💰

Your digital product checkout is more than a payment button. 👀 If you sell ebooks, templates, courses, guides, Canva templates, or other digital products, you need to think about what happens after someone clicks “buy.” Before selling your first digital product, make sure you have: 1️⃣ Purchase terms — what the customer is actually agreeing to when they buy. 2️⃣ License & use restrictions — what they can and cannot do with your product. 3️⃣ Privacy Policy — especially if you’re collecting customer information. 4️⃣ Website/store terms — the rules governing purchases and use of your store. 5️⃣ Protection against unauthorized sharing & reselling — because your digital product should not become the internet’s free download. 😭 Your creativity is an asset. Treat it like one. And remember: your legal protection shouldn’t start after someone steals or misuses your digital product. It should be part of your business from the beginning.
